title: Pre-registration index — strategies frozen before the first tip of the 2026-11-19 .. 2026-11-22 slate
rule: Per the project brief: every strategy's signal, thresholds, universe and exact settlement rule are frozen before the first bet of the slate. Files are hash-chained into data/ledger/ledger.json at publication.
universe: all 26 games on the official 2026-11-19 .. 2026-11-22 slate (data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-19_39b70241.json: 2026-11-19=4, 2026-11-20=9, 2026-11-21=6, 2026-11-22=7); source file data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-19_39b70241.json; window rule = the newest official schedule capture, today (UTC) + up to 3 days per the project brief
prior_vintage_settled: data/settlement/settlement_2026-11-17.json settles the 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-18 games of the 2026-11-17..20 vintage (ledger entries 13-14, 5-12-0, -14.8 paper units); its four published SGPs stay open in that file and are graded by the addendum data/settlement/sgp_grades_2026-11-17.json where official box-score evidence exists. Earlier vintages remain settleable from data/archive/.
